description: [Read · free] Return a person's full employment timeline from the position graph. Only for people connected to you: they engaged with posts you can see in Flux, are in one of your campaigns or segments, or you pulled them (an engagement pull, or their profile via linkedin_profile_info / linkedin_profile_posts). Anyone else returns not-found with a next_step to pull their profile via linkedin_profile_info. Sorted current-first, then most-recent past by started_at desc. Pure DB read — no LinkedIn pull, no credits charged.
name: get_engager_position_history
title: Engager Position History
